from pathlib import Path
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import zlib

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = Path('C:/Users/Marko/Desktop/Projects/llmx')
artifact = repo/'docs/benchmarks/cpu-decode-caller-cost-20260920.json'
analysis = json.loads((root/'analysis.json').read_text())
assert analysis['status'] == 'pass'
state = json.loads((root/'timing/results.json').read_text())
files = []
for p in root.iterdir():
    if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.py','.json','.hpp','.cpp','.bat','.stdout','.stderr','.patch') and p.name != 'update-goals.py':
        files.append(p)
for folder in ['plain-src','spans-src','instrumented-src','review','timing']:
    for p in (root/folder).rglob('*'):
        if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and p.suffix not in ('.f32','.warmup','.exe','.obj','.pdb'):
            files.append(p)
for folder in ['profiler-capability','profiler-capability-minimal','native-sampling']:
    for p in (root/folder).iterdir():
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.py','.cpp','.bat','.json','.stdout','.stderr'):
            files.append(p)
    filtered = root/folder/'target-samples.csv'
    if filtered.exists():
        files.append(filtered)

evidence = []
payloads = {}
for p in sorted(set(files)):
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    assert text.encode('utf-8') == raw
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    evidence.append(dict(path=p.relative_to(root).as_posix(), sha256=digest, bytes=len(raw)))
    payloads.setdefault(digest, text)

vectors = []
vector_payloads = {}
for row in state['rows']:
    for suffix in ('.f32','.f32.warmup'):
        p=root/'timing'/(row['name']+suffix)
        raw=p.read_bytes()
        digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        assert digest==state['plan']['historical_vector_sha256']
        vectors.append(dict(path=p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),sha256=digest,bytes=len(raw)))
        vector_payloads.setdefault(digest,base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(raw)).decode('ascii'))

result = dict(schema='llmx-diagnostic-evidence-v1',date='2026-09-20',
              checkpoint_base='4be2872f3c7043c8fb6fc3c947b3e46e3bf85a01',
              production_runtime='bf122fd00440366a704b81c36d4d7c8884384e2b',
              scope='Scratch-only CPU caller attribution and native sampling capability; no runtime optimization, HF/mx acceptance, merge or GitHub publication.',
              plan=json.loads((root/'plan.json').read_text()),analysis=analysis,
              native_sampling=json.loads((root/'native-sampling/summary.json').read_text()),
              evidence=evidence,text_by_sha256=payloads,
              vectors=vectors,vector_encoding='base64(zlib(raw little-endian float32))',
              vector_by_sha256=vector_payloads,
              archive_limits='Raw system-containing ETL/events.csv files and binaries/PDBs stay local. Archive contains target-only sampled events, commands, exact source and hashes. Reproduction requires recorded toolchain and pinned real model. Identical text/vector payloads are stored once; every path retains a byte count and SHA256.')
artifact.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True)+'\n',encoding='ascii')
print('Archived',len(evidence),'evidence paths;',len(payloads),'distinct text payloads;',len(vectors),'vectors;',len(vector_payloads),'distinct vector payloads;',artifact.stat().st_size,'bytes')

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = root / 'spans-src'
target = root / 'instrumented-src'
if target.exists():
    raise SystemExit('instrumented-src already exists; refusing overwrite')
shutil.copytree(source, target)

def once(text, before, after):
    if text.count(before) != 1:
        raise ValueError('source anchor count differs: ' + before[:100])
    return text.replace(before, after, 1)

p = target / 'backends/cpu/cpu_backend.hpp'
text = p.read_text()
text = once(text, '#include "worker_spans.hpp"', '#include "worker_spans.hpp"\n#include "caller_probe.hpp"')
text = once(text, '    void run_parallel(F&& fn) {\n',
            '    void run_parallel(F&& fn) {\n        caller_probe::Scope caller_parallel_scope(caller_probe::ParallelEnter);\n')
text = once(text, '        worker_probe::Record* record = probe.begin();',
            '        worker_probe::Record* record;\n        { caller_probe::Observer observer; record = probe.begin(); }')
for name, tag in [('matmul', 'Matmul'), ('matmul_group', 'Group'), ('attention', 'Attention')]:
    pattern = r'(    void ' + name + r'\([^{}]*?\) override \{\n)'
    text, count = re.subn(pattern, r'\1        caller_probe::Scope caller_primitive_scope(caller_probe::PrimitiveEnter, caller_probe::' + tag + ');\n', text)
    if count != 1:
        raise ValueError('primitive anchor count differs: ' + name)
p.write_text(text, encoding='ascii', newline='\n')

p = target / 'model/arch_qwen.hpp'
text = p.read_text()
text = once(text, '#pragma once\n', '#pragma once\n#include "caller_probe.hpp"\n')
begin = text.index('    std::vector<float> step(int token_id) {')
end = text.index('    // Process a whole prompt', begin)
step = text[begin:end]
step = once(step, '    std::vector<float> step(int token_id) {\n',
            '    std::vector<float> step(int token_id) {\n        caller_probe::Scope caller_step_scope(caller_probe::StepEnter);\n')
step = once(step, '        for (int l = 0; l < cfg.n_layer; l++) {\n',
            '        for (int l = 0; l < cfg.n_layer; l++) {\n            caller_probe::region(caller_probe::LayerInput);\n')
for anchor, region in [
    ('            // per-head q/k norms', 'HeadMathCache'),
    ('            // attn_output projection + residual', 'AttentionOutput'),
    ('            for (int i = 0; i < cfg.n_ff; i++) {', 'SwiGLU'),
    ('            // down projection + residual', 'DownPrepare'),
    ('        // final norm + output projection', 'FinalPrepare'),
    ('        n_tokens_++;', 'TokenReturn')]:
    indent = anchor[:len(anchor) - len(anchor.lstrip())]
    step = once(step, anchor, indent + 'caller_probe::region(caller_probe::' + region + ');\n' + anchor)
residual = '            for (int i = 0; i < cfg.n_embd; i++) x_[i] += h_[i];'
if step.count(residual) != 2:
    raise ValueError('residual anchor count differs')
first = step.index(residual)
step = step[:first] + '            caller_probe::region(caller_probe::AttentionResidual);\n' + step[first:]
last = step.rindex(residual)
step = step[:last] + '            caller_probe::region(caller_probe::DownResidual);\n' + step[last:]
text = text[:begin] + step + text[end:]
p.write_text(text, encoding='ascii', newline='\n')

changed = []
for p in source.rglob('*'):
    if p.is_file() and p.read_bytes() != (target / p.relative_to(source)).read_bytes():
        changed.append(str(p.relative_to(source)))
if set(changed) != {'backends\\cpu\\cpu_backend.hpp', 'model\\arch_qwen.hpp'}:
    raise ValueError('unexpected changed files: ' + repr(changed))
print(json.dumps({'changed': changed, 'sha256': {
    str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    for p in [root / 'caller_probe.hpp', target / 'backends/cpu/cpu_backend.hpp', target / 'model/arch_qwen.hpp']
}}, indent=2))

import collections
import copy
import json

REGIONS = ['cache_embedding', 'layer_input_norm_qkv_arguments',
           'qk_norm_rope_kv_attention_arguments', 'attention_output_clear_arguments',
           'attention_residual_ffn_norm_gate_arguments', 'swiglu',
           'down_clear_arguments', 'down_residual_loop',
           'final_norm_logits_allocation_arguments', 'token_increment_return']

def union(xs):
    result = []
    for a, b in sorted(xs):
        assert a <= b
        if a == b:
            continue
        if result and a <= result[-1][1]:
            result[-1] = (result[-1][0], max(b, result[-1][1]))
        else:
            result.append((a, b))
    return result

def subtract(xs, ys):
    xs, ys = union(xs), union(ys)
    result = []
    j = 0
    for a, b in xs:
        while j < len(ys) and ys[j][1] <= a:
            j += 1
        k, cursor = j, a
        while k < len(ys) and ys[k][0] < b:
            c, d = ys[k]
            if cursor < c:
                result.append((cursor, min(c, b)))
            cursor = max(cursor, d)
            if cursor >= b:
                break
            k += 1
        if cursor < b:
            result.append((cursor, b))
    return result

def size(xs):
    return sum(b-a for a, b in union(xs))

def intersect(xs, ys):
    return subtract(xs, subtract(xs, ys))

def disjoint(xs):
    assert all(a <= b for a, b in xs)
    assert all(xs[i][1] <= xs[i+1][0] for i in range(len(xs)-1))

def validate(doc, nsteps=32, pattern=None):
    if pattern is None:
        pattern = [1, 2, 0, 1, 0] * 36 + [0]
    c = doc['caller']
    assert c['overflow'] is False and c['invalid'] is False
    start, end = c['start_ns'], c['end_ns']
    outer_start, outer_end = doc['tg_start_ns'], doc['tg_end_ns']
    assert outer_start <= start < end <= outer_end
    events = c['events']
    assert 0 < len(events) <= c['capacity']
    scopes = {0: [], 2: [], 4: []}
    stack = []
    pairs = {0: [], 2: [], 4: []}
    observers, region_spans = [], [[] for _ in REGIONS]
    region = None
    last = start
    for event in events:
        assert len(event) == 4 and all(type(v) is int for v in event)
        kind, tag, a, b = event
        assert 0 <= kind <= 7 and start <= a <= b <= end and a >= last
        last = a
        observers.append((a, b))
        if kind in (0, 2, 4):
            assert (kind == 0 and not stack) or (kind == 2 and stack and stack[-1][0] == 0) or (kind == 4 and stack and stack[-1][0] == 2)
            if kind == 0:
                assert region is None
                region = (0, a)
            elif kind == 2:
                assert tag in (0, 1, 2)
            stack.append((kind, tag, a))
        elif kind in (1, 3, 5):
            assert stack and stack[-1][0] == kind-1 and stack[-1][1] == tag
            opening, _, lo = stack.pop()
            pairs[opening].append((lo, a, tag))
            if kind == 1:
                assert region is not None
                region_spans[region[0]].append((region[1], a))
                region = None
        elif kind == 6:
            assert stack and stack[-1][0] == 0 and region is not None and 0 <= tag < len(REGIONS)
            region_spans[region[0]].append((region[1], a))
            region = (tag, a)
        else:
            assert stack and stack[-1][0] == 4
    assert not stack and region is None
    steps = [(a, b) for a, b, _ in pairs[0]]
    prim = [(a, b) for a, b, _ in pairs[2]]
    parallel = [(a, b) for a, b, _ in pairs[4]]
    assert len(steps) == nsteps and len(prim) == len(parallel) == nsteps * len(pattern)
    assert [tag for _, _, tag in pairs[2]] == pattern * nsteps
    assert sum(e[0] == 7 for e in events) == len(parallel)

    assert size(subtract(prim, steps)) == 0 and size(subtract(parallel, prim)) == 0
    dispatch = []
    assert len(doc['tg']) == len(doc['tg_publish']) == len(parallel)
    for r, pub, p, q in zip(doc['tg'], doc['tg_publish'], prim, parallel):

        assert r[0] >= 0 and all(0 <= a <= b <= r[0] for a, b in zip(r[1::2], r[2::2]))
        returned = pub + r[0]
        assert p[0] <= q[0] <= pub <= returned <= q[1] <= p[1]
        dispatch.append((pub, returned))

    observed = subtract(observers, dispatch)

    harness = subtract(subtract([(start, end)], steps), observed)
    categories = {'dispatch': size(dispatch), 'backend_caller': size(backend),

    assert sum(categories.values()) == end-start
    region_totals = {name: size(intersect(model, spans)) for name, spans in zip(REGIONS, region_spans)}
    assert sum(region_totals.values()) == categories['model_side']
    sub = collections.defaultdict(list)

        sub['parallel_before_publish'].append((q[0], d[0]))
        sub['parallel_after_return'].append((d[1], q[1]))
        sub['primitive_after_parallel'].append((q[1], p[1]))
    backend_parts = {k: size(subtract(v, observed)) for k, v in sub.items()}
    assert sum(backend_parts.values()) == categories['backend_caller']
    fringe = {'before_trace': start-outer_start, 'after_trace': outer_end-end}
    assert sum(categories.values())+sum(fringe.values()) == outer_end-outer_start
    return {'steps': len(steps), 'primitives': len(prim), 'events': len(events),
            'inner_ns': end-start, 'outer_ns': outer_end-outer_start,
            'categories_ns': categories, 'model_regions_ns': region_totals,
            'backend_parts_ns': backend_parts, 'outer_fringe_ns': fringe,
            'accounting_gap_ns': 0,
            'limits': 'Instrumented elapsed intervals; explicit observer brackets do not enclose all observer effects. Model-side includes serial norm/RoPE backend calls. No production saving is established.'}

def selftest():
    # Independently specified timeline with known dispatch, nested scopes,
    # model tags, explicit observation, and harness fringe.
    doc = {'tg_start_ns': 0, 'tg_end_ns': 110, 'tg_publish': [40],

           'caller': {'start_ns': 5, 'end_ns': 100, 'capacity': 100,
                      'overflow': False, 'invalid': False,
                      'events': [[0,0,10,12],[2,0,20,22],[4,0,30,31],
                                 [7,0,32,34],[5,0,72,74],[3,0,80,82],
                                 [6,5,85,87],[1,0,90,92]]}}
    result = validate(doc,1,[0])
    assert result['categories_ns'] == {'dispatch':30,'backend_caller':23,
                                     'model_side':14,'harness':13,
                                     'explicit_observer':15}, result
    rejected = 0
    cases = []
    def case(path, value):
        d = copy.deepcopy(doc); p = d
        for key in path[:-1]: p = p[key]
        p[path[-1]] = value
        cases.append(d)
    case(['caller','overflow'],True)
    case(['caller','invalid'],True)
    case(['caller','capacity'],1)
    case(['caller','start_ns'],-1)
    case(['caller','events',1,0],3)
    case(['caller','events',2,1],9)
    case(['caller','events',3,2],80)
    case(['caller','events',7,3],101)
    case(['tg_publish',0],10)
    case(['tg',0,0],100)
    case(['tg',0,2],31)
    case(['tg_publish'],[])
    for d in cases:
        try: validate(d,1,[0])
        except (AssertionError,IndexError): rejected += 1
        else: raise AssertionError('malformed trace accepted')
    assert size(union([(0,10),(5,15),(15,20)])) == 20
    assert subtract([(0,20)],[(5,10),(8,15)]) == [(0,5),(15,20)]
    return {'valid_fixtures': 1, 'malformed_rejected': rejected,
            'union_difference_checks': 2, 'known_partition': result}
